name: so101_bench_real_2_v2.1
description: A collection of real-world StackOverflow-derived examples intended to evaluate models on programming Q&A and code-related tasks. The benchmark measures model ability to retrieve or generate correct answers / code snippets from real posts and assesses practical performance on noisy, real user content.
evaluation_method: exact_match / pass@k (code-retrieval/generation metrics); BLEU or edit-based scores may also be used
reputation: Community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for evaluating code/QA systems; not a widely established benchmark like CodeX or HumanEval.
